outlier_investigation_note: Original naive-warm-started optimization (14.8% error, 49 evals, genuine convergence per L-BFGS-B) got stuck in a bad local optimum specific to this combo. Confirmed via 3 alternative starting points (zero, LTV warm-start, random) all converging to 0.12-0.33% error, consistent with the rest of the grid. Not a target-distance scaling artifact (checked and ruled out: shift=40 has an even smaller target_distance with normal error). Corrected value uses the LTV warm-start result (10 evals, 0.12% error, the best and fastest of the three alternatives tried). Original value preserved in rel_err_ceiling_original_naive_warmstart for the record.
